---
title: "Car Crash Detector - Neural Network"
format: html
---

## AI-Powered Car Crash Detection

Upload a photo of a car, and our neural network will analyze it with a heatmap showing which areas influenced the decision.

**Note:** Please upload JPG or PNG images only.

```{=html}
<div class="car-detector-app">
  <div class="upload-section">
    <input type="file" id="imageInput" accept="image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/png" />
    <button id="analyzeBtn">Analyze Car</button>
  </div>
  
  <div id="preview-section" style="display: none;">
    <h3>Original Image:</h3>
    <img id="imagePreview" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 400px; border-radius: 8px;" />
  </div>
  
  <div id="result"></div>
  
  <div id="heatmap-section" style="display: none;">
    <h3>Neural Network Heatmap Analysis:</h3>
    <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #666; margin-bottom: 10px;">
      The heatmap shows which regions the neural network focused on when making its decision.
      Red/yellow areas had the most influence on the prediction.
    </p>
    <img id="heatmapImage" style="max-width: 100%; max-height: 400px; border-radius: 8px;" />
  </div>
  
  <div id="summary-section" style="display: none;">
    <h3>AI Analysis:</h3>
    <div id="summaryText"></div>
  </div>
</div>


<style>
.car-detector-app {
  margin: 20px 0;
  padding: 30px;
  border: 2px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
}

.upload-section {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

#imageInput {
  padding: 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  border: 2px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background-color: white;
  margin-right: 10px;
}

#analyzeBtn {
  padding: 12px 24px;
  font-size: 16px;
  background-color: #4CAF50;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: bold;
  transition: background-color 0.3s;
}

#analyzeBtn:hover {
  background-color: #45a049;
}

#analyzeBtn:disabled {
  background-color: #ccc;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

#preview-section, #heatmap-section, #summary-section {
  margin: 20px 0;
  padding: 15px;
  background-color: white;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

#result {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  min-height: 60px;
  font-size: 18px;
}

.result-crashed {
  background-color: #f8d7da;
  border: 2px solid #dc3545;
  color: #721c24;
}

.result-not-crashed {
  background-color: #d4edda;
  border: 2px solid #28a745;
  color: #155724;
}

.result-error {
  background-color: #f8d7da;
  border: 2px solid #dc3545;
  color: #721c24;
}

.result-loading {
  background-color: #d1ecf1;
  border: 2px solid #17a2b8;
  color: #0c5460;
}

#summaryText {
  padding: 15px;
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-left: 4px solid #667eea;
  border-radius: 4px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-size: 16px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.confidence-section {
  margin-top: 15px;
  padding-top: 15px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  font-size: 16px;
}

.confidence-section strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.model-info {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #666;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>

<script>
// Neural Network API endpoint
const API_URL = 'https://car-crash-detector-nn-800819952729.us-central1.run.app/predict';

let selectedImage = null;

// Handle image selection
document.getElementById('imageInput').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if (file) {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      selectedImage = event.target.result;
      document.getElementById('imagePreview').src = selectedImage;
      document.getElementById('preview-section').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('heatmap-section').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('summary-section').style.display = 'none';
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }
});

// Handle analyze button click
document.getElementById('analyzeBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const resultDiv = document.getElementById('result');
  const analyzeBtn = document.getElementById('analyzeBtn');
  const heatmapSection = document.getElementById('heatmap-section');
  const summarySection = document.getElementById('summary-section');
  
  if (!selectedImage) {
    resultDiv.className = 'result-error';
    resultDiv.innerHTML = '❌ Please select an image first';
    return;
  }
  
  // Show loading state
  analyzeBtn.disabled = true;
  analyzeBtn.textContent = 'Analyzing with Neural Network...';
  resultDiv.className = 'result-loading';
  resultDiv.innerHTML = '🧠 Analyzing your car image with deep learning... This may take 15-30 seconds.';
  heatmapSection.style.display = 'none';
  summarySection.style.display = 'none';
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ 
        image: selectedImage 
      })
    });
    
    const data = await response.json();
    
    if (response.ok) {
      let className = '';
      if (data.status === 'crashed') {
        className = 'result-crashed';
      } else if (data.status === 'not_crashed') {
        className = 'result-not-crashed';
      }
      
      resultDiv.className = className;
      
      let html = `<strong>${data.message}</strong>`;
      
      if (data.confidence) {
        html += `
          <div class="confidence-section">
            <strong>Model Confidence:</strong>
            ${data.confidence}%
            <div class="model-info">Powered by ${data.model_type || 'EfficientNetB0'}</div>
          </div>
        `;
      }
      
      resultDiv.innerHTML = html;
      
      // Show heatmap if available
      if (data.heatmap_image) {
        document.getElementById('heatmapImage').src = data.heatmap_image;
        heatmapSection.style.display = 'block';
      }
      
      // Show Claude's summary if available
      if (data.claude_summary) {
        document.getElementById('summaryText').textContent = data.claude_summary;
        summarySection.style.display = 'block';
      }
      
    } else {
      resultDiv.className = 'result-error';
      resultDiv.innerHTML = `❌ Error: ${data.error || 'Unknown error occurred'}`;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    resultDiv.className = 'result-error';
    resultDiv.innerHTML = `❌ Error: ${error.message}`;
  } finally {
    analyzeBtn.disabled = false;
    analyzeBtn.textContent = 'Analyze Car';
  }
});
</script>
```
